args.function: async () => { const txt = (s) => (s || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const vis = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; }; const re = /(^|\s)40(''|"|″|”)\s*1-Drawer$/; const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,p,span,div,button,a')].filter((e) => vis(e) && re.test(txt(e.innerText))); if (!nodes.length) return { notFound: true, sample: [...new Set(document.body.innerText.split('\n'))].filter((s) => /Drawer/.test(s)).slice(0, 8) }; nodes.sort((a, b) => a.innerText.length - b.innerText.length); const el = nodes[0].closest('button,a,[role=button]') || nodes[0]; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); el.click(); return 'clicked ' + txt(nodes[0].innerText); }

async () => { const t=(x)=>(x||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const q=()=>document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Matte White"]'); let b=q(); if(!b){ const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>t(x.innerText)==="Countertop Color"); if(h){h.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000)); b=q();} } if(!b) return "NOT FOUND Matte White"; if(b.disabled||b.getAttribute("aria-disabled")==="true") return "DISABLED Matte White: "+t(b.closest('div')&&b.closest('div').innerText).slice(0,120); b.scrollIntoView({block:"center"}); b.click(); return "clicked "+b.getAttribute("aria-label"); }
